name: todo-app
description: Weekly To-Do List app (MERN): React + Tailwind client, Express + MongoDB API, deployable on Netlify.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:memory -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
